summary: Both halves inspected and the dense word corrections enlarged. The apostrophe follows the pen-retouched s of lovers;the cancelled next character remains tentatively a. Has has a typed s over d. Roles has typed r over i and o over t;living has v over g. Doors has o over r. Have and words contain pen retouching;this has typed i over e and a retraced s. The u of Our bears a pen cup above and two small curved marks below. The cancelled letter in text-books and the extra mark after breasts remain unreadable or tentative;the close-up cue is preserved below the line. Journal intime has no independent comma. Two faint points after and in the personal paragraph remain tentatively a colon. The heavy but regular apostrophe in mothers is not silently assigned to handwriting.
